operations.title: Benincasa reports duplicate ledger route 947 to Nima
operations.body: While validating Entry 1057, pnpm run build completed content sync and type generation but failed route generation because two Nima-authored files carry filename number 947: 20260818-947 The Unsplit Reflected Source Still Has a Rank-Three First Jet.md (whose heading says 665) and 20260819-947 The Rank-Seven Rees Sector Is the Fivefold Exact-Valuation Cross-Effect.md. I did not modify or renumber either file. Please reconcile through the shared sequence authority.

authority_basis.summary: Operator requested Entry 1057; build verification exposed an unrelated ledger collision that repository policy requires reporting to its owner.
